content.value_statement: Broad video requests need a workflow that keeps design, motion, and media decisions consistent. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through custom HyperFrames video creation.
actual_capabilities: Routes broad video requests to a general HyperFrames workflow when no specialized skill fits.
Guides discovery for audience, platform, priority, and useful variations.
Requires design-system grounding before choosing colors, fonts, and layout density.
Plans scene structure, rhythm, timing, layout, and animation handoff.
Documents shared audio setup for voiceover, music, sound effects, and captions.
Provides a final checklist for HyperFrames linting, validation, inspection, and handoff.
limitations: It is not intended for live data rendered at playback time.
It does not perform NLE-style editing of a completed video file.
It depends on other HyperFrames skills and reference files for full execution.
It renders an MP4 only when the user explicitly asks for final export.

use_cases.title: Build Brand Motion Pieces
use_cases.description: Create sizzle reels, launch intros, title cards, or static loops with consistent design rules.

use_cases.title: Plan Product Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Turn a broad product video request into scenes, pacing, audio needs, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Author HyperFrames Compositions
use_cases.description: Use a structured workflow for modular scenes, animation references, media tracks, and output checks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Title Card
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one short visual composition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 6-second HyperFrames title card for our product launch. Use our brand colors from frame.md and keep it text-forward.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Short Brand Montage
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that needs discovery and scene planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan and build a 20-second brand montage for a website hero. Ask only for missing audience, platform, and priority details first.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Narrated Explainer Segment
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with audio and captions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45-second narrated HyperFrames video with three scenes, voiceover, music, sound effects, captions, and a final validation checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Modular Multi-Scene Video
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert request that needs references, reusable scenes, and strict handoff checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a modular 90-second video with reusable scene components, defined rhythm, foreground detail, audio tracks, transitions, and inspect-ready output.

output_examples.input: Create a 10-second launch intro for a developer tool.
output: A concept angle for the tool and audience.
A grounded visual identity using the project design references.
A short scene plan with layout, motion, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Add voiceover and captions to a short multi-scene video.
output: A neutral audio request plan for narration, music, and sound effects.
Caption placement guidance tied to the shared media metadata.
A handoff checklist for preview and final export decisions.

output_examples.input: Make a looping hero animation for a website.
output: A compact composition plan that avoids unnecessary scenes.
Layout guidance for safe margins, density, and foreground detail.
Animation routing to the relevant HyperFrames references.

best_practices: Provide audience, platform, duration, brand assets, and priority before requesting a broad video.
Build the final visible layout before adding GSAP or transition motion.
Run HyperFrames lint, validation, and inspection before handing off the preview.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill when a specialized HyperFrames workflow clearly matches the request.
Do not skip design references and invent colors, fonts, or layout rules from memory.
Do not add extra scenes, music, captions, or effects that the user did not request.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for custom HyperFrames video requests that do not clearly match a specialized video workflow.

faq.question: Does it create final MP4 files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It delivers the preview first and renders an MP4 only when explicitly requested.

faq.question: Can it handle narrated videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes narration, music, sound effects, and captions through the shared HyperFrames media workflow.

faq.question: Does it replace design specifications?
faq.answer: No. Existing frame.md, design.md, or DESIGN.md files take priority over generated style choices.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What does the workflow validate?
faq.answer: It checks linting, structural validation, layout inspection, contrast warnings, and final preview readiness.
